claims.claim: no third-party dependency is imported anywhere in the package
only sandbox.py may spawn a process; there is no network-capable import
all 23 catalog Skills have a production handler and none is a stub
every Skill declares the payload fields it accepts and rejects the rest
a payload cannot grant itself filesystem reach
with no executor, blocking gates are undecided and the run does not pass
an undecodable source file lowers coverage; a binary asset does not
a declared adapter level never exceeds the native engine level
every corpus case is byte-identical across repeated dispatch
every catalog Skill has at least one Golden-corpus case
every corpus case is byte-identical in a fresh process with a new hash seed
a pinned clock is threaded into every Skill that timestamps its output
a snapshot materializes to disk without inventing content for a file it cannot reproduce
the pure core's cross-file rename survives a real pytest run over the materialized tree
the sandbox refuses a non-allowlisted binary, an escaping cwd and leaks no host environment
a timed-out command blocks the run and can never satisfy a gate
the suite is proven to fail on a real injected defect

liveExecution.note: the live layer runs a real pytest and a real ruff through SubprocessExecutor over a materialized tree; when no toolchain is installed the live tests skip and the suite says so rather than reporting a pass
